work.title: Untitled (Planes and Targets) 1
work.description: Mixed-media collage on white paper featuring two top-down warplane silhouettes aligned vertically along a central axis of stacked compact discs and ribbon stripes. Soccer ball, bullseye targets, concentric spiral motifs, and scattered perforated dots populate the surrounding white ground.
work.composition: vertical axis with scattered peripheral elements
keywords: soccer ball and compact disc mixed media
